lockups.title: Logo lockups
lockups.lead: Pick by background. The full-colour marks are for normal use; the single-colour marks are for small sizes and one-colour printing.
captions: Full colour, dark backgrounds. The default.
Full colour with the tagline, dark backgrounds.
Single colour with the red streak, for small sizes and one-colour print.
Full colour with the tagline, white and off-white backgrounds.
lockups.clearSpaceNote: Clear space: keep at least the height of the “K” free on all sides. Never place the light-background lockup on navy — the “KU” disappears. For anything else, or for vector originals, email us.
